column1: # Complete driver error conversion source evidence lands atomically with campaign 03.

column5: One typed authority translates every direct source branch: KV identities and sized arguments, TiKV and TiFlash timeout/busy identities, all five interruption signals with TiKV versus Executor class fidelity, current and legacy GC argument shapes, stale/max-ts/lock/region/token/unknown identities, result-undetermined, all three PD resource-group branches, and chain-preserving passthrough. The Rust boundary is a closed StorageDriverError enum rather than concrete client-go/PD errors, accepts no nil reference, models only linear Context wrappers rather than arbitrary Go Is/As or multi-error traversal and branch priority, and does not reproduce Go stack capture, so the source remains PARTIAL rather than claiming runtime equivalence.
